question: What golf course lie within 100 kilometers relative to Texas Health Heart & Vascular Hospital Arlington, Arlington, TX in the northwest direction?
sql:
WITH origin AS  (SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-97.116453 32.748716)',4326)::geography AS geometry)
SELECT * FROM pois, origin
WHERE ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-97.116453 32.748716)',4326)::geography, 100000)
AND leisure = 'golf_course'
AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(origin.geometry, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN 292.5 AND 337.5;

[3].display_name: Texas Health Heart & Vascular Hospital Arlington, Arlington, TX

poi.poi_name: Texas Health Heart & Vascular Hospital Arlington
